name: Keyword Data Fetcher
description: Fetches real search-market metrics (volume, difficulty, CPC, related terms) for an entity's candidate head terms from a configurable keyword-metrics provider, BEFORE seo-planner runs. Candidate terms come from analysis_json when present, from the entity's seed fields when not. Emits a keyword_data enriched field (terms, market, fetched_at, empty gsc_terms placeholder for skeleton GSC hydration). Loud failure on auth/quota/cost-cap — never a silent empty.

options.label: Keyword metrics provider
options.description: Provider config: base_url, auth (basic_env with login_env/password_env naming env vars), endpoints.overview (bulk volume/difficulty/CPC) and endpoints.related (related terms per seed). All provider knowledge lives here, not in code.

options.label: Markets (location names)
options.description: Search markets as provider location_name strings. First entry is the primary market: it fills keyword_data.terms and is the only market related terms are fetched for. Additional markets land in keyword_data.other_markets.

options.label: Language code
options.description: Provider language_code sent with every request.

options.label: Max candidate terms
options.description: Cap on candidate head terms sent to the overview endpoint (one bulk call per market). Keeps cost to cents per entity.

options.label: Fetch related terms for top N
options.description: Fetch related/suggested terms for the top-N terms by measured volume (primary market only). Each fetch is a separate billed call (~$0.013 observed). 0 disables.

options.label: Related terms per seed
options.description: Max related terms returned per seed term.

options.label: Cost cap per entity (USD)
options.description: Hard per-entity spend cap, checked against provider-reported per-call cost before each call. Tripping it stops further calls and marks the entity item status=error (loud), preserving data fetched so far. 0 means spend nothing (all calls blocked), not unlimited.

options.label: Empty result is an error
options.description: When true, an entity yielding zero candidate terms (or zero metrics rows) becomes a loud error item instead of a success item with empty terms.
